description: CMS Open Payments (Sunshine Act): payments from drug/device makers and GPOs to US physicians, practitioners and teaching hospitals, live from CMS (total_count: CMS's filtered count). payment_type: general (meals, travel, consulting, speaker fees, royalties), research, ownership (physician stakes). Payer as filed, no ticker. summarize=true: CMS's yearly totals per company and nature (only year, company apply). Disclosure ≠ wrongdoing: these are lawful, statutorily disclosed payments.
